title: Act correctly on capped streets and when short of chips
description:
As a learner, I want the action bar to reflect a capped street or a short stack, so that I always see exactly the options the rules allow.

Extends the action bar (E03-S02). When the street is capped (4 bets), Raise is not offered. When the user's stack is smaller than the call amount, Call is labelled "Call all-in $<stack>" and Raise is not offered. When the stack exceeds the call amount but is smaller than a full bet or raise, the bar offers "Bet all-in $X" (no bet facing) or "Raise all-in to $X" (bet facing) (REQ-017.7); whether a short all-in reopens betting for players who already acted follows REQ-016.5 (engine, E01-S12): under half a full bet does not reopen. In a sit-and-go, amounts are chip numbers without $ (e.g. "Call 40"). Engine support: cap E01-S10, all-in E01-S12, sit-and-go game type E01-S16.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-017 (Must): Legal actions only — The engine shall accept only legal actions for the player to act, and the Table screen shall offer the user only the legal actions with their exact amounts.
- REQ-022 (Must): Action bar — When it is the user's turn, the Table screen shall show an action bar of buttons labelled with the action and its exact amount, plus a Hint button, operated by mouse or touch.

Covers: REQ-017, REQ-022

Plan key: E03-S06 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the user faces the fourth bet on the flop at $4/$8, When the action bar is shown, Then it offers exactly Fold and "Call $4" and no Raise [REQ-017.2, REQ-022.1]
Given the user has $3 and faces a $4 bet, When the action bar is shown, Then it offers Fold and "Call all-in $3" and no Raise [REQ-017.3, REQ-022.1]
Given the user has exactly $4 and faces a $4 bet, When the action bar is shown, Then it offers Fold, "Call $4" and no Raise [REQ-017.3]
Given a sit-and-go hand where the user faces a bet of 40 chips, When the action bar is shown, Then the labels read "Call 40" and "Raise to 80" with no $ sign [REQ-022.1]

Given 100,000 seeded states covering capped streets and short stacks at table sizes 2-10, When the action bar is built, Then the offered actions and amounts equal the engine's legal set in every state [REQ-017.2, REQ-017.3, REQ-017.7]

Given the user has $6 with nothing in the pot this street and faces a $4 bet on the flop at $4/$8, When the action bar is shown, Then it offers exactly Fold, "Call $4" and "Raise all-in to $6" [REQ-017.7, REQ-022.1]
Given the user has $3 with no bet facing on the flop at $4/$8, When the action bar is shown, Then it offers exactly Check and "Bet all-in $3" and no Fold [REQ-017.7, REQ-022.1]

Given the user bet $4 on the flop and a bot then raises all-in to $5 (less than half a full raise) and the others call, When the action returns to the user, Then the bar offers Fold and "Call $1" and no Raise [REQ-017.7]

Given capped streets and short stacks, When the action bar is built, Then actionLabel shows 'Call all-in $X', 'Bet all-in $X' and 'Raise all-in to $X' (and chip labels without '$' in sit-and-go), and the TASK-3.2 legalActions property is widened to capped and short-stack states
Given an idle action-bar button whose disabled attribute is removed in the DOM, When it is clicked, Then a test shows the table state is unchanged
